source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Record the date and time of the safety check.
3. Include the exact model number, serial number, and location of the appliance.
4. Document each test conducted according to the manufacturer's specifications.
5. Record test equipment used, its calibration date, and its ID if applicable.
6. Note the name(s) of the technician(s) performing the check.
7. Detail all observed defects, malfunctions, or failures.
8. Provide a description of specific faulty components like wiring, switches, plugs, or heating elements that were identified during the check.
9. Record any error messages or codes that appeared during testing.
10. State any visible signs of damage like burns, melted parts, or broken casings.
11. Include in the record any safety concern that was identified and could not be immediately remedied.
12. Record actions taken, such as removal of the appliance from service, temporary fixes, or professional repair recommendations.
13. Attach photographs or
